card.title: Galaxy S10 No Touch

claims.statement: Galaxy S10 touch needs VDD_TSP_1.8V and VDD_TSP_3.0V, which are only present with the phone powered on.
If both touch supplies are missing, the AP PMIC U12019 is the likely fault; it is not underfilled but storage and CPU sit on the opposite side, so limit heat.
A line reading far lower than expected (e.g. 0.1 or 0.0 instead of about 0.5) is a short, found by voltage injection with a thermal camera; OL means an open line to trace in boardview.

procedure: Inspect touch and LCD FPC connectors for physical or liquid damage.
Diode-check touch FPC pins against known values.
Measure VDD_TSP_1.8V and VDD_TSP_3.0V with the phone on.
Replace U12019 if both are missing; replace damaged FPC connectors.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Overheating the board near U12019 can damage the storage chip and CPU on the reverse side.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
